newsitem.title: USA: Emerging debt spreads tighter, Bulgaria key gainer.
newsitem.headline: Emerging debt spreads tighter, Bulgaria key gainer.

text.p: Emerging debt prices ended the New York trading session on a positive note as spreads continued to narrow across the board with Bulgaria emerging as key gainer on the day, traders said.
Traders said spreads of actively traded Bradies tightened on average by about 12 basis points with Bulgaria debt emerging as a key gainer on the day.
"The market still looks cheap "on spread" versus other products," one trader said. "It's continues to perform very well."
